_about: The numbered parts on a chapter's specimen drawing, keyed by chapter id (the owner's decisions of 25 Oct 2026, Lithography, and 29 Oct 2026, Silicon and Wafers, Memory and HBM and Advanced Packaging, from the labels mockup; add a chapter only from a sourced list). Each part has its number (n), its name, the shorter name its label on the drawing carries where the list's name is long (label), and either its maker as the chapter's card and text source it (maker, with link: [href, words] where a section of the chapter covers it) or the chapter that covers it (stage, a chapter id, shown as 'see stage NN, Title'). Where a part has no maker of its own, maker is a short phrase from the chapter's text (approved by the owner, 29 Oct 2026). build/build.js draws the list under the specimen's caption. Since 21 Nov 2026 the specimen is an exploded technical plate (src/plate.js, plates/<specimen>.js): its numbered labels take their names from here (label, else name), and the part each lights is set in the plate's model to match the part's light table. 'light' lists the shapes the point-cloud drawing lit when the reader pointed at a part, in the old specimen's own units (specimens/<specimen>.js): a rod from one point to another with its radius (r), a ball round a point (r), or a box between two corners; soft is the width of the edge over which the light falls off; only keeps it to the ink or the accent points, which the plate reads too; layers [y, pitch, half] keeps it to thin layers. 'at' lists the points the old drawing's balloon pointed at, in the same units, kept as the record of where each part is.
